description:
## Problem
Steps 8, 9 and 10 need the official `TPC-DI_Tools_v1.1.0.zip` and the separate Appendix archive (specification page 117). Both are behind the TPC's request form, which the agent must not fill in.

## Owner decisions
- 2026-11-21: source of shipped tools: "The official archive you place at ~/Developer/tpc-tools/, with SHA-256 recorded. The data and audit steps wait for it."

## Action (owner)
Download both archives from tpc.org and place them under `~/Developer/tpc-tools/`. Tell the agent.

## Decision gates
The agent never downloads from behind the form and never substitutes the copy in the Databricks project.

## Verification rubric
Pass: both files exist at that path; the agent records each file's name, size and SHA-256 on this item and unblocks steps 8, 9 and 10.
